translations.web: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.
translations.bsb: Showing partiality to the wicked is not good, nor is depriving the innocent of justice.
translations.kjv: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.
translations.asv: To respect the person of the wicked is not good, Nor to turn aside the righteous in judgment.
